title.narrative: Strengthening rights and access to education through provision of inclusive, clean and healthy learning environments in schools.

description.narrative: Global objective: To contribute to the empowerment of children and young people through increased access to equitable and inclusive education in Zambia. Specific objective: To improve the learning environment for children and young people, particularly girls, young women and children with disabilities in target schools in Mwandi and Nkeyema Districts, by improving and supporting accessible, gender-sensitive school WASH facilities and education services, incl. MHM, and empowering communities and learners to demand and hold government accountable.
